items.comparator: Compared with its previous operating baseline; no specific baseline period stated.
items.quantitative_outcome: At Wanhua Chemical’s Ningbo chlor-alkali facility, the report says AI-based systems resulted in “a 50% reduction in total equipment alarms and an early-warning accuracy exceeding 95%.” It also reports that autonomous operations generated “annual value exceeding RMB 10 million.”
items.signal: Reported plant-level AI benefits at a chemical facility, but the article does not specify the comparison period or independently validate the figures; treat as a weak signal.
items.source: Futunn report on SUPCON Technology’s industrial AI deployments

items.comparator: Not stated; the report describes annual savings for wood-products customers but gives no pre-AI baseline or calculation method.
items.quantitative_outcome: The report says Hexion highlighted “a $30 million in annual savings for wood-products customers.” No comparison baseline is stated.
items.signal: AI linked to customer-site operating data could create a distinctive feedback loop for product formulation; the reported savings are potentially material but lack a stated baseline or independent validation.

items.comparator: For the specialty-chemicals yield example, the source gives an initial yield of 72% and a resulting yield of nearly 90%; it does not identify the client, process, or measurement period.
items.quantitative_outcome: The article says Deep Principle “improved production yield from 72% to nearly 90%” in one specialty-chemicals project. It also reports a separate model result: “cutting average prediction error by 14.6%” under a test condition described as closest to real-world R&D.
items.signal: An AI-and-autonomous-lab feedback loop is associated with a reported yield increase, while project identity and measurement details are not disclosed. The source is an ACCESS Newswire company release, so treat as a weak signal.
items.source: ACCESS Newswire article about Deep Principle’s AI Materials Factory

items.comparator: Four internal reviewers and experienced external consultants reviewed the same 1,061 pages; Enveda Quality adjudicated comments. Timed review compared with the reviewers’ almost 26 hours.
items.quantitative_outcome: “Across its runs, the CDP identified all 11 actionable issues found during the human review.” The timed run “reduced total review time from almost 26 hours for Enveda’s four reviewers to just under three hours,” an 89% reduction, including human adjudication.
items.signal: AI-assisted review of Phase 2 manufacturing batch records matched the actionable issues found by human reviewers and substantially reduced review time in this reported evaluation.

items.quantitative_outcome: Anthropic reports Claude generated “roughly 35,000 antibody designs in about a month.” In early tests, Divergence found three designs that could bind to IgE and 20 that could dislodge it; three of those 20 “appeared to dislodge IgE more than the standard medication.”
items.signal: AI-generated antibody candidates produced early experimental hits, including candidates reported to outperform a standard medication on IgE displacement; no quantitative head-to-head margin was stated.
items.source: Anthropic, reporting its research partnership case study

items.comparator: Blinded comparisons with reports generated by single AI agents; human biology experts reviewed the reports.
items.quantitative_outcome: The system analyzed PerturbAI’s whole-brain atlas and synthesized findings in 32 minutes. In blinded comparisons, human experts preferred the reasoning-agent interpretations “75% of the time.”
items.signal: A reasoning-agent system applied to PerturbAI’s in vivo causal-genomics data produced expert-preferred interpretations more often than single-agent reports in the stated blinded comparison.
items.source: PerturbAI and OpenAI, as reported by The AI Journal

items.quantitative_outcome: Outcome: none stated. The announced Cascade dataset is planned to combine 100 million single-cell RNA-seq profiles with more than 11,000 proteomic secretome profiles across more than 150,000 perturbation conditions; partner commitments include GSK, Pfizer, and Sanofi.
items.signal: Distinctive planned multimodal immune-response dataset, with pharmaceutical and biotech partners committed. The report describes intended usefulness for predictive AI models, but gives no measured model or operating outcome.
items.source: Genetic Engineering & Biotechnology News, reporting the Parse Biosciences–Nomic Bio announcement

items.signal: Expanded access to its proprietary insurance intelligence—underwriting, premium-audit and property-level weather information—through Amazon Quick, Microsoft Copilot and Claude. This is a distinctive data-access move, but the announcement reports no measured operating benefit.

Relm joined Project Eleven as a development partner to explore how post-quantum security controls could be assessed in digital-asset insurance underwriting. The partnership could provide access to distinctive underwriting evidence and risk criteria, but it is explicitly exploratory and reports no measured outcome.
items.source: Project Eleven and Relm announcement distributed by CNW

items.comparator: Compared with its own operations approximately one year earlier; the release also compares customers using Aurora MDR with endpoint coverage against customers using endpoint detection and response alone.
items.quantitative_outcome: Arctic Wolf reported that agentic AI resolves 60% of investigations; human-only investigations fell from 81% to 2%; monthly investigation volume rose 21% while alert volume declined 19%; and average time from an alert-generating event to an actionable ticket fell 36%. It also reported seven times fewer events escalating to investigation for Aurora MDR customers with endpoint coverage versus customers using endpoint detection and response alone, and an approximately 12x cost advantage versus building and operating an agentic SOC in-house.
items.signal: The company reports operational outcomes at scale, drawing on data from more than 11,000 organizations in over 100 countries and processing more than 10 trillion security events weekly. This is a potentially differentiating operating signal, but the figures are company-reported and the source does not describe an independent evaluation.
items.source: Arctic Wolf, 2026 Agentic Security Operations Report press release

items.comparator: For benchmark results, Google compared Gemini 4 Carbon with other models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5; for secure-code generation it compared Carbon with its predecessor, Gemini 4 Argon. Google said its Chrome team compared patch generation with a large frontier model from a rival lab, not named in the source.
items.quantitative_outcome: Google reported 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro, 54.8% on ExploitGym, and 71.0% on CWE-bench. It said Carbon was “more than twice as successful as Argon at writing secure code” and that its Chrome team found Carbon “outperformed a large frontier model from a rival lab by more than 10 times” at generating high-quality patches. These are benchmark and internal-test results, not measured customer operating outcomes.
items.signal: The benchmark scores and internal comparisons indicate capability rather than demonstrated workflow, cost, or customer benefit. Google’s controlled early access for cyber defenders could provide a route to differentiated feedback, but the source does not quantify that data advantage.
items.source: SecurityWeek, reporting Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon announcement and company-provided results

items.signal: Orange Cyberdefense became Mistral AI’s first European managed security services provider design partner, with early access to a cybersecurity-optimized variant of Mistral Large 4. The stated work includes penetration testing, technical audits, post-incident analysis, and investigation. This is a distinctive early-access partnership and European operating-environment arrangement, but the announcement reports no measured outcome.

items.comparator: Live commercial-network trials in New York City; the article does not identify the comparison baseline or methodology.
items.quantitative_outcome: “16% improvement in downlink user throughput,” “12% higher spectral efficiency,” and “10% increase in downlink data volume.”
items.signal: AI-managed beamforming trials reported three quantified network performance gains, with the article noting gains especially during peak hours. The results are promising but the source does not detail the control comparison.

items.comparator: Estimate is specific to Dangote’s Lekki refinery at full-capacity throughput; no before/after or alternative-operations baseline is stated.
items.quantitative_outcome: Honeywell estimates Forge Plant Cognition “could deliver operational benefit of more than 29 cents a barrel” and “more than $60 million in gross benefit per year” at full capacity. The release labels this a preliminary estimate, not a realized result.
items.signal: AI refinery optimization is being deployed at a named, complex facility, with a facility-specific projected benefit. The refinery context may make the workflow and data difficult to reproduce, but this is a forecast rather than a measured realized outcome.
items.source: Honeywell, “Honeywell Technologies Launches Forge Plant Cognition with Dangote, Built with NVIDIA AI, Dell Technologies”

items.comparator: Compared with no explicit baseline or external control in the release; value is aggregated across customers and reported as tracked and validated by Cognite’s value team.
items.quantitative_outcome: “over $1 billion in verified, realized value.” The release says reduced downtime and production costs accounted for 36% of the value, frontline productivity gains 27%, and increased production 26%.
items.signal: Cognite reports customer-aggregated realized value tied to operational KPIs. The release does not disclose the customer-level calculations or independent validation, so treat as a candidate signal rather than an independently established outcome.
items.source: Business Wire, “Cognite Reports $1 Billion in Verified AI Value, Confirming Impact of Industrial AI Solutions”
